boards.name: Lever
boards.notes: Parent Employ Inc. is named in the site footer. Pricing is by custom quote on request. Partner program page lists integration partnerships. No language options or own-domain API page found.

sources.title: About Employ (footer)
sources.quote: Employ, JazzHR, Lever, and Jobvite are registered trademarks of Employ, Inc.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: To get Lever pricing, you’ll need to contact Lever directly for a custom quote.

sources.title: Partner program
sources.quote: Build an integration, reach new customers, and become part of the hiring workflow teams rely on every day.

boards.name: Oracle Taleo
boards.notes: Product page describes an Oracle partner network with more than 200 Taleo-certified offerings. Partner page describes the program as flexible. No pricing, API or language options found on the pages read.

sources.title: Taleo product page, certified partner ecosystem
sources.quote: Gain access to Oracle’s extensive partner network, featuring more than 200 Taleo-certified offerings and innovative integrations with LinkedIn.

sources.title: Partner program
sources.quote: Our partner program gives you choice and flexibility so you can tailor it to best meet your needs.

boards.name: Pinpoint
boards.notes: Developer docs say the API uses a key generated in account settings. Pricing is by request. Partner page describes referral and integration partnership programs.

sources.title: Authentication

sources.title: Request pricing
sources.quote: See the product and get pricing

sources.title: Partner with us
sources.quote: Join our referral or integration partner program and access benefits for you and your customers.
